description: Main-belt asteroids for display only (not simulated): JPL SBDB osculating elements of the first 10000 numbered asteroids of orbit class MBA, in number order. Positions at other times use two-body propagation from the database epoch.
source: JPL SBDB Query API; raw response backend/presets/sources/reference-orbits/sbdb-main-belt.json (D-064)
frame: Heliocentric ecliptic and mean equinox of J2000.0
